reading.body:
The Texas Advanced Computing Center operates the Cortex supercomputer on the University of Texas J.J. Pickle Research Campus in Austin, Texas. The operator has not published power capacity, floor area, or cooling specifications for this facility. Without these figures, the scale of Cortex relative to other AI compute infrastructure cannot be assessed.

Texas has 18 facilities with published power specifications totaling 468 megawatts. This campus does not appear in that count because TACC has not published its power capacity. The state context ranks this facility 19th by published megawatts, suggesting earlier capacity figures may exist in archived data; however, current specifications are unavailable.

The location and operator are verified through academic sources. Cortex is a research computing system operated by a university center, which typically means it serves multiple research teams rather than a single AI training or inference workload. Without published power or hardware specifications, this facility cannot be evaluated as a constraint or enabler of AI scaling.
